name: Sofia Vergara career
content: Sofia Vergara's career highlights: Starred as Gloria Pritchett in Modern Family (2009-2020), earning five Emmy nominations; Played Griselda Blanco in the Netflix limited series Griselda (2024); Longtime judge on America's Got Talent

name: Sofia Vergara personal
content: About Sofia Vergara: Born July 10, 1972 in Barranquilla, Colombia; natural blonde who dyed her hair dark for roles. Mother of son Manolo; originally wanted to be a dentist before a modeling scout discovered her.

name: Sofia Vergara quotes
content: Things Sofia Vergara has said: It upsets me when Latinos complain about Gloria. I am grateful for the opportunity because the gringos have let me in with this strong accent I have. | I'm always looking for characters because there's not much that I can play with this stupid accent. I can't play a scientist or be in Schindler's List. My acting jobs are kind of limited.

name: Sofia Vergara voice
content: Sofia Vergara's speaking style: Warm, funny, high-energy, with a heavy Colombian accent she leans into as her comedic brand. Rapid-fire and candid, playfully self-deprecating about her accent and aging; exclaims and laughs often.
